jobs.title: Chief Administrative Officer - Technology, Operations & Business Enablement
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) serves as the strategic business partner to the Chief Platform Officer (CPO), helping drive organizational effectiveness, platform adoption, stakeholder engagement, and execution across the Platform organization.

This role acts as the connective tissue between business leadership, infrastructure, operations, product, and technology teams, ensuring strategic priorities are translated into measurable outcomes. The CAO will lead business management, governance, communications, operating rhythm, organizational planning, and client engagement initiatives for the Platform organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, relationship management, operational excellence, and executive leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizations and influence senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Business Management

Partner closely with the Chief Platform Officer to define and execute strategic priorities.
Drive the annual planning process, including objectives, key results, investment priorities, and resource allocation.
Manage the Platform organization's operating model and governance framework.
Develop executive-level reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness and scalability.

Client & Business Engagement

Establish and oversee a client engagement model that strengthens relationships between Platform teams and business stakeholders.
Act as a senior liaison between business functions, operations teams, and infrastructure leadership.
Ensure business priorities, service expectations, and platform capabilities remain aligned.
Facilitate executive discussions regarding platform strategy, service adoption, and business outcomes.
Champion a service-oriented culture focused on stakeholder satisfaction and business enablement.

Operating Committee & Governance

Lead governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews.
Coordinate cross-functional decision-making across business, operations, technology, risk, and vendor organizations.
Drive issue identification, escalation management, and resolution processes.
Establish clear accountability and transparent decision frameworks.

Organizational Effectiveness

Manage staffing strategy, workforce planning, organizational design, and location strategy.
Partner with Finance and Human Capital Management on budgeting, headcount planning, and talent initiatives.
Lead internal communications, employee engagement programs, and leadership offsites.
Drive change management and adoption initiatives associated with transformation programs.

Portfolio & Execution Management

Provide oversight of strategic initiatives across the Platform organization.
Monitor execution against milestones, budgets, and strategic objectives.
Ensure alignment between platform investments and business priorities.
Develop reporting and communication materials for senior executive stakeholders.

External & Industry Engagement

Monitor industry trends and emerging practices in platform management, infrastructure services, client engagement, and operating models.
Support vendor and strategic partner relationships.
Represent the Platform organization in selected internal and external forums.

Qualifications

Required Experience

12+ years of experience in business management, strategy, operations, consulting, platform management, or related leadership roles.
Experience supporting senior executives in complex, matrixed organizations.
Demonstrated success partnering across business, operations, product, and technology functions.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Experience leading enterprise-scale initiatives and organizational transformation efforts.

Preferred Experience

Financial services, asset management, banking, or fintech experience.
Experience supporting platform, infrastructure, operations, or enterprise services organizations.
Knowledge of governance, risk management, and service management frameworks.
Experience managing executive communications and board-level presentations.

Applicants must be authorized and have the right to work in the country where the role is located without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Compensation Details

The salary range for this role is $200,000-$250,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in the job posting location. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, business sector, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, market benchmarking data, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. This job is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, which, along with base salary and retirement contributions, is part of our total comprehensive package. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, retirement, life insurance and other benefits to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, production, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

jobs.title: Director of Technology & Business Systems - Bilingual in Spanish
jobs.description:
Salary: to $150,000 base + discretionary bonus
Reports to: CEO
Location: Stafford, TX
Fluent Spanish required

Do you love being the bridge between the business and the people who build its systems? Our client, a growing company, is seeking a technology leader who can turn real operational needs into well-designed software and systems, then lead the team that brings them to life.

You'll guide a Mexico-based software development team, partner closely with the CEO and department leaders, and oversee the full technology picture, including business systems, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance. You don't need to write code yourself. You do need to understand how software and systems are designed well enough to define requirements, weigh tradeoffs, and ask the right questions before resources are committed.

Your impact:
• Translate business challenges into clear technical requirements, system designs, and development priorities
• Lead projects end to end, from requirements and design through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support
• Build and own the technology roadmap, budget, and KPIs, and share progress, risks, and recommendations with executive leadership
• Make sure the infrastructure is secure, reliable, and scalable across on-premises and cloud environments
• Oversee user provisioning, access controls, software licensing, hardware lifecycle, and employee technical support
• Hold the MSP, consultants, and technology vendors accountable for service, security, and results
• Partner with the Compliance Officer on ISO 27001, audits, business continuity, and disaster recovery
• Bring fresh ideas for automation, AI tools, integrations, and process improvement
• Step in hands-on to troubleshoot whenever the situation calls for it

Your background:
• A proven track record leading people and managing multiple technology projects at the same time
• Experience managing or partnering closely with software development teams across the full development lifecycle
• Familiarity with application architecture, databases, APIs, integrations, cloud applications, and source control
• Exposure to ERP systems, custom software, or other business application platforms
• A solid grasp of networking, servers, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, firewalls, identity and access management, backups, and disaster recovery
• Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and risk management
• ISO 27001 or similar security framework experience, with a strong habit of documentation and audit readiness
• The business judgment to prioritize wisely and the confidence to present costs, risks, and options to executives
• Fluency in Spanish (required)

Bonus points for:
• Hands-on development, systems engineering, or infrastructure configuration experience
• Experience building or growing the technology function at a small or mid-sized company

If you're a collaborative, organized leader who gets energized by connecting technology to business results, let's talk.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology - HR, Legal & Compliance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Senior Director of Technology to lead the technology organization supporting our HR, Legal, Compliance, Audit, and Communications functions. This is a highly visible role for a leader who can operate equally well in strategic planning sessions with senior executives and in the operational details of platform roadmaps, budgets, and staffing. The ideal candidate has deep experience leading enterprise technology teams supporting corporate/enabling functions, has managed large budgets and diverse platform portfolios, and has the executive presence and organizational savvy to act as a trusted extension of leadership across the broader organization. This role leads a team of 30–40 technologists and manages an annual technology portfolio budget exceeding $50M, spanning core platforms, ancillary systems, and change/run investment across multiple business functions.

Responsibilities

Technology Leadership

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, and delivery for the HR, Legal, and Compliance functions, ensuring platforms and capabilities align with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards.
Serve as the primary technology leader for Human Resources technology, with Workday as the core HRIS platform, alongside a broader ecosystem of ancillary tools ensuring integration, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
Lead technology for Audit and Compliance, with FinScan as the primary platform for financial crime/sanctions screening, ensuring the platform scales with regulatory and risk requirements.
Provide technology oversight and support for Legal and Communications functions; ensure appropriate governance, tooling, and support model is in place.
Manage the full technology portfolio budget ($50M+ annually), including capital and operating spend, vendor contracts, licensing, and resource allocation across all supported functions.
Own capacity and demand management across the portfolio — balancing run-the-business needs with strategic initiatives, prioritizing investment against business value, and ensuring transparent trade-off decisions with stakeholders.
Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap for each function, incorporating platform modernization, AI/automation opportunities, risk reduction, and regulatory change.
Ensure strong data governance, security, and compliance posture across all platforms, particularly given the sensitivity of HR, Legal, and Compliance data.

Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of 30–40 technology professionals (direct and matrixed), including managers, engineers, product/platform leads, and business analysts.
Build a high-performing, engaged organization; establish clear career paths, performance management practices, and succession plans.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery.
Manage vendor and partner relationships, including systems integrators and platform providers, to ensure quality delivery and cost efficiency.

Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technology partner and trusted advisor to senior business leaders across HR, Legal, Compliance, Audit, and Communications (typically SVP/EVP level and their leadership teams).
Build strong, credible relationships across a diverse set of stakeholders with differing priorities, translating business needs into technology strategy and vice versa.
Represent technology in business planning, budget reviews, and steering committees; communicate complex technical topics in clear, business-relevant terms.
Manage escalations and competing priorities across functions with diplomacy and sound judgment.
Partner closely with enterprise technology leadership (architecture, security, infrastructure, data) to ensure alignment with broader technology strategy.
Act as a strategic partner and force multiplier for the Head of Corporate Systems and Data, driving key organizational initiatives, executive communications, and cross-functional coordination.
Manage the operating rhythm for the executive's organization: leadership meetings, offsites, town halls, business reviews, and reporting cadences.
Lead or coordinate special projects and strategic initiatives on behalf of the executive, often requiring rapid synthesis of ambiguous problems into clear plans.
Prepare executive-level communications, board/leadership presentations, and briefing materials.

Serve as a key liaison between the executive's office and other business/technology leaders, ensuring alignment and follow-through on commitments.
Help shape organizational strategy, workforce planning, and culture initiatives across the broader technology organization.
Exercise discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive information.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years managing large, complex technology organizations (30+ FTE) and multi-year budgets exceeding $50M.
Demonstrated experience leading technology for corporate/enabling functions such as HR, Legal, Compliance, Audit, or Finance.
Direct experience with core HR technology platforms (Workday strongly preferred) and familiarity with the broader HCM/talent technology ecosystem (e.g., talent marketplace, engagement, culture platforms).
Experience with compliance/risk technology platforms (e.g., financial crime, sanctions/AML screening tools such as FinScan, or comparable) is a strong plus.
Familiarity with audit management platforms (e.g., TeamMate) a plus.
Proven track record of strategic planning translated into disciplined execution — able to operate at both the vision level and in delivery detail.
Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills; able to build trust and influence across senior leaders with diverse priorities.
Strong financial acumen: budget planning, portfolio prioritization, vendor negotiation, and capacity/demand management.
Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Executive presence with the gravitas to represent technology in front of senior business leaders and, at times, the Board.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, driving structure and clarity where it doesn't yet exist.
Strong people leader with a track record of developing talent and building high-performing, resilient teams.
High integrity and discretion, given exposure to sensitive HR, legal, and compliance matters.
Skilled at balancing competing priorities across multiple functions without losing sight of the bigger picture.

Organizational Scope

Team size: 30–40 technology professionals
Annual budget: $50M+ portfolio
Functions supported: HR, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and Communications
Key platforms: Workday; Gloat, CultureAmp, Culture Cloud; FinScan; TeamMate
Reports to: Head of Corporate Systems and Data
Direct reports: 6-8 managers/leads across HR Technology, Compliance/Audit Technology, and Legal/Communications Technology support

Working Conditions

Hybrid-Office environment (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays)
Occasional travel ( Travel may be required for leadership meetings, business planning sessions, offsites, vendor engagements, or cross-functional governance forums

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

Compensation

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $220K - $285K. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations (Philadelphia, PA; Cedar Rapids, IA; Denver, CO). Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

About The Function

Enterprise Technology is a global Aegon/Transamerica organization that enables the business to move quickly and deliver the best possible outcomes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure.

With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data & analytics, risk & controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development.

Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change.

jobs.title: Director Superconducting Technology Architect
jobs.description:
The Superconducting Technology Architect is a Director-level technical leadership role within the GF Labs Technology Architecture organization. This role defines and advances foundry platforms for superconducting qubits, Josephson-junction digital logic, cryogenic control and readout, and related integration. The position requires deep technical expertise, platform leadership, and the ability to translate emerging system requirements into scalable, manufacturable technologies.

Job Summary

The Superconducting Technology Architect leads the definition, development, and delivery of superconducting quantum and digital technologies and associated customer programs. The position integrates device, process, design, test, packaging, foundry operations, and program execution; guides internal and external R&D; and serves as a senior technical and customer-facing authority for GF leadership and partners.

Essential Responsibilities

Develop and influence long-term roadmaps for superconducting qubits, SFQ-family digital logic, cryogenic control and readout, parametric amplifiers, interconnect, and packaging.
Translate customer and system requirements into materials, process flows, device structures, design rules, PDK content, test vehicles, and acceptance criteria.
Shape manufacturable qubit technologies spanning Josephson junctions, resonators, couplers, readout, low-loss materials and interfaces, coherence, fidelity, variability, and yield.
Define scalable digital platforms, including RSFQ, ERSFQ/eSFQ, RQL, and AQFP, addressing junction uniformity, timing, wiring, inductance, power, memory, thermal budgets, and cryogenic I/O.
Lead process integration, experiments, simulations, tape-outs, cryogenic characterization, technology transfer, qualification, and new-product introduction across superconducting logic, qubits, cryo-CMOS, multi-chip modules, TSVs, flip-chip, and heterogeneous integration.
Build and govern internal and external development programs with customers, universities, research organizations, government laboratories, suppliers, and startups, including technical scope, proposals and estimates, milestones, schedules, budgets, IP, and transition plans.
Lead multidisciplinary engineering and program teams; recruit and mentor talent; drive quality, schedule, budget, and customer commitments; and communicate architecture choices, execution status, risks, and investment priorities to customers and GF executives.
Drive foundry operational improvement through cycle-time reduction, SPC and control-plan maturity, manufacturing systems, process quality, program reviews, and schedule-risk reduction.
Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications

Education: MS or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Materials Science, or a related discipline.
Years of Experience: 15+ years in semiconductor technology, superconducting electronics, quantum hardware, or advanced process integration, including leadership of complex technology programs.
Deep expertise in Josephson-junction devices, superconducting qubits and/or digital logic, cryogenic operation, RF/microwave circuits, materials and interface loss, and device-to-system tradeoffs.
Demonstrated success translating architectures into foundry processes and transferring technologies from research into fabrication, qualification, or manufacturing, with ownership of quality, schedule, budget, and customer deliverables.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering and program organizations and strategic collaborations across customers, research organizations, suppliers, startups, and matrixed internal functions.
Percentage of travel: 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD with industrial experience in superconducting qubits, superconducting digital electronics, Josephson-junction fabrication, or cryogenic system integration.
Experience with transmon-class qubits, microwave resonators, control/readout, parametric amplifiers, decoherence mechanisms, and cryogenic measurement.
Experience with SFQ-family circuit design, simulation, layout, timing, and 3D electromagnetic modeling; familiarity with RQL is beneficial.
Knowledge of superconducting materials and junction processes, multi-chip modules, thermal or superconducting TSVs, flip-chip interconnect, heterogeneous integration, cryo-CMOS, cryocoolers, wafer-scale integration, and cryogenic packaging.
Experience with proposal development, technical basis-of-estimate, integrated schedules, Agile execution, manufacturing systems, SPC, control plans, and customer or executive program reviews.

We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. They are comfortable discussing OAS, prepayment, and structured finance models with traders and risk managers in one meeting, reviewing Python or Java implementations with developers in the next, and partnering with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams on platform architecture and controls. They possess excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and thrive in entrepreneurial environments where they can help scale technology capabilities alongside a growing business.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Strong understanding of securitized products risk analytics, including OAS, dv01 and duration measures, prepayment and loss models, deal modeling, and tranche analytics.

Strong programming and technical skills, including Python, Java, SQL, and infrastructure/security configuration.
Excellent communication skills with a demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Trading, Risk, Operations, and Technology stakeholders.
Proven ability to operate effectively in both leadership and hands-on technical capacities within a small, high-performing team environment.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.
